results.title: Sex Differences in Overhand Throwing are Completely Due to Socialization: A Blan
results.reason: This paper is a commentary on evolutionary biology and gender studies, focusing on sex differences in throwing behavior. It does not address clinical psychology practice, therapy, assessment, diagnosis, psychopathology, mental health interventions, or neuropsychology. The content is theoretical and academic in nature, with no clinical applications or implications for practicing therapists, psychologists, or psychiatrists.
